purpose: 仅23既登记定位原返回，按返回序选择同原全国稿，一次GET，失败不换源
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor,as_completed
import hashlib,json,re,requests
root=Path.cwd(); out=root/"reports/research/510300_actual_loan_allocation_full_original_source_v1"
def now():return datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def rel(p):return p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def save(name,x):
    p=out/name
    if p.exists():raise RuntimeError("原定位/取得产物已存在，禁止重复："+rel(p))
    p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
protocol=read(out/"protocol.json")
assert sha((out/"protocol.json").read_bytes())=="493fe260705bdd2f8ec9a09b4ca771162eceec21172b8050ea879e7fca8ec2ad"
assert len(protocol["fixed_queries"])==23
chosen=[]
for spec in protocol["fixed_queries"]:
    q=spec["quarter"]; p=out/f"固定定位原返回_{q}_E116.json"
    raw=read(p); tool=raw["tool_result"]; value=tool.get("value","")
    if not isinstance(value,str):value=json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False)
    headers=list(re.finditer(r"(?m)^([^\n]+?) \((https?://[^)\s]+)\)\s*$",value))
    candidates=[]; selection=None
    year=q[:4]; label={1:"一",2:"二",3:"三",4:"四"}[int(q[-1])]
    expected=year+"年"+label+"季度金融机构贷款投向统计报告"
    expected_year_end=year+"年金融机构贷款投向统计报告"
    for i,m in enumerate(headers):
        segment=value[m.end():headers[i+1].start() if i+1<len(headers) else len(value)]
        title=m[1].strip();url=m[2];domain=urlparse(url).hostname or ""
        intro=re.sub(r"\s+","",title+" "+segment[:1200])
        identity=expected in intro or (q[-1]=="4" and expected_year_end in intro)
        official=domain=="gov.cn" or domain.endswith(".gov.cn") or domain=="pbc.gov.cn" or domain.endswith(".pbc.gov.cn")
        candidate={"rank":i+1,"native_search_title":title,"url":url,"official_domain":official,
                   "fixed_original_year_quarter_title_match":identity,"search_prefix_not_quantity_or_publication_proof":segment[:1200]}
        if selection is None and official and identity:
            selection={"quarter":q,"rank":i+1,"url":url,"native_search_title":title,"matched_original_title":expected if expected in intro else expected_year_end,
              "source_clock_and_quantity_pending":True,"raw_search_return":{"path":rel(p),"sha256":sha(p.read_bytes())}}
            candidate["selected"]=True
        else:candidate["selected"]=False
        candidates.append(candidate)
    row={"quarter":q,"candidates":candidates,"selected":selection,"unknown_if_no_match":selection is None}
    chosen.append(row)
save("全部二十三固定定位选择_取得前已冻结_E116.json",{"at":now(),"rows":chosen,"all_fixed_queries_completed":23,"chosen_before_any_GET":True,
 "no_extra_queries":True,"no_success_source_selection_after_GET":True})
selections=[x["selected"] for x in chosen if x["selected"]]
assert len({x["url"] for x in selections})==len(selections),"不同原期误选同URL"
for spec in selections:
    save(spec["quarter"]+"_唯一原稿首GET认领_E116.json",{"at":now(),"selection":spec,"attempt":1,"retry":0,
      "allow_redirects":False,"authenticated":False,"protocol_sha256":sha((out/"protocol.json").read_bytes())})
def getone(spec):
    q=spec["quarter"]; rec={"at_started":now(),"selection":spec,"attempt":1,"retry":0,"allow_redirects":False,"TLS_verify":True,"authenticated":False}
    try:
        session=requests.Session();session.trust_env=False
        session.headers.update({"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)","Accept":"text/html,application/pdf,*/*"})
        response=session.get(spec["url"],timeout=(12,30),allow_redirects=False,verify=True);session.close()
        raw=response.content; suffix=".pdf" if raw.startswith(b"%PDF") or "application/pdf" in response.headers.get("Content-Type","").lower() else ".html"
        fp=out/(q+"_唯一原稿首次响应_E116"+suffix)
        if fp.exists():raise RuntimeError("原响应已存在")
        fp.write_bytes(raw)
        rec.update({"at_completed":now(),"http_status":response.status_code,"response_url":response.url,
          "content_type":response.headers.get("Content-Type"),"redirect_location":response.headers.get("Location"),
          "bytes":len(raw),"path":rel(fp),"sha256":sha(raw),"encoding_hint":response.encoding,"apparent_encoding_hint":response.apparent_encoding,
          "HTTP_Date_not_publication":response.headers.get("Date"),"Last_Modified_not_publication":response.headers.get("Last-Modified"),
          "status":"RAW_FIRST_RESPONSE_QUANTITY_CLOCK_PENDING"})
    except Exception as exc:
        rec.update({"at_completed":now(),"http_status":None,"status":"ONE_GET_FAILED_NO_RETRY","error_type":type(exc).__name__,"error":str(exc)})
    save(q+"_唯一原稿首GET回执_E116.json",rec)
    return rec
receipts=[]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
    jobs=[pool.submit(getone,spec) for spec in selections]
    for job in as_completed(jobs):
        rec=job.result();receipts.append(rec)
        print(json.dumps({"原期":rec["selection"]["quarter"],"首次GET状态":rec["http_status"],"字节":rec.get("bytes"),
             "原量钟":"待解析","不重试":True},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
summary={"at":now(),"actual_fixed_queries":23,"selected_original_sources":len(selections),"first_GETs":len(receipts),
 "HTTP200":sum(x.get("http_status")==200 for x in receipts),"locator_misses":[x["quarter"] for x in chosen if x["selected"] is None],
 "selected_sources":[{"quarter":x["quarter"],"url":x["url"]} for x in selections],
 "new_GET_retries":0,"extra_queries":0,"alternate_carriers":0,"authenticated_requests":0,"live_process":False}
save("全部固定定位与首次取得终态_E116.json",summary)
print(json.dumps({"全部定位取得终态":True,"固定查询":23,"选中首GET":summary["first_GETs"],"HTTP200":summary["HTTP200"],
 "无匹配原期":summary["locator_misses"],"既存复用":6,"金融候选":0,"模型拟合":0},ensure_ascii=False))
